posts.meta_description:
858 likes, 19 comments - lonelyplanet on October 28, 2026: "Derry in Northern Ireland goes all out for Halloween, and for good reason. “There's lots of history to absorb here,” says Lonely Planet contributor Ester Pyykkö of this city that “compellingly blends the past and modernity.” You’ll want to join the fun at what Derry calls the biggest Halloween festival in Europe, of course, but save time to walk the city walls, visit the Museum of Free Derry and enjoy a trad music session at a pub, too. Link in bio for all your Derry must-dos 🔗

📸: @biantunesl".

posts.meta_description: 1,077 likes, 26 comments - lonelyplanet on October 27, 2026: "Matcha fans – add this small Japanese town, known as "the matcha capital of the world" for producing premium green tea, offering matcha workshops and more, to your itinerary. "You can go from sipping tea at a teahouse founded in 1160 to literally grinding your own leaves into powder," says Lonely Planet Correspondent @jesseogn. Uji is around 20 minutes from Kyoto by train and is worth a true half-day trip "rather than just a stop on the way somewhere else," he says.".

posts.meta_description: 688 likes, 20 comments - lonelyplanet on October 25, 2026: "GUIDE TO THE VENETO, ITALY 🇮🇹 “This northeastern region brings together the best of the Bel Paese,” says Lonely Planet contributor Julia Buckley. “But it often gets overlooked in the hyperfocus on its capital, Venice.” Of course, then you’d miss out on Padua’s history, Chioggia’s canals, the pink-tinged Dolomites and so much more. Link in bio for #BestInTravel, the best places to visit in 2027 🔗".

posts.meta_description:
707 likes, 23 comments - lonelyplanet on October 24, 2026: "Fun, quirky and multicultural: this is Montréal. Your must-dos? Savor Montréal-style bagels hot from the wood oven at @stviateurbagel, stroll the Montréal Museum of Fine Arts (@mbamtl) and take a dip at @botabotamtl, spa-sur-l'eau (yes, this Scandinavian spa is on a boat). In other words, bundle up and get ready to wander. Link in bio for #BestInTravel, the best places to visit in 2027 🔗

📸: @alexihobbs".

posts.meta_description: 560 likes, 9 comments - lonelyplanet on October 23, 2026: "Never been to the South Pacific? French Polynesia, one of Lonely Planet's 2027 Best in Travel picks, makes for a great first-time getaway. “People think of it as a far-flung luxury destination, but’s it’s actually only an eight-hour flight from LAX (take @airtahitinui), and you can make it affordable,” says Lonely Planet editor Jessica Lockhart (@wynnelockhart). Her tip? “If you’re headed to one of the less touristed islands, it pays to brush up on your French (or download a good translation app) and learn a few words of Ma’ohi (Tahitian).” Link in bio for her full itinerary 🔗".

posts.meta_description: 912 likes, 18 comments - lonelyplanet on October 22, 2026: ""Ramen alley" tops our list of things to do in Sapporo, Japan, because it's thought to be the birthplace of the city's famous miso-rāmen 🤤 Follow Lonely Planet editor @melissayeagr as she slurps her way through with @hokkaidolove.intl: "If you want to be there when the alley is buzzing, come at night. If you want to beat the crowds, come on the off-hours of midafternoon or earlier in the evening." Link in bio for more recs from our new Hokkaido classic guidebook 🇯🇵".

posts.meta_description: 380 likes, 19 comments - lonelyplanet on October 20, 2026: "“You are witnessing part of Earth’s history,” says Lonely Planet Correspondent @tonatiuhhigareda, who went to Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula to explore Chicxulub Beach, near where the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs struck, and the Ring of Cenotes that formed in its aftermath. Tonatiuh grew up swimming in these cenotes and hearing stories of dinosaurs, Mayan gods and mythical “aluxes” believed to protect the land. Want to experience millions of years of history yourself? He suggests visiting between November-March, which may be peak season but typically has less rain and cooler temps.".
